answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Shares & Investments Question ID: 6678 Country: India Title: I want to know that share market & inssurance are legal or ilrgal but why.give me complete answer.thanking you. Question: Assla Alaikum. I want to know that share market & inssurance are legal or ilrgal but why.give me complete answer.thanking you. allah hafiz Answer ID: 6678 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 669/669=M/1429) It is a business to invest money in share market which is lawful with some conditions, while insurance is an interest based transaction, therefore unlawful. A business is lawful and interest is unlawful, as the Holy Quran said: أحل الله البيع وحرم الربوا ( Allah has permitted sale, and prohibited riba/usury ). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
